output.summary: Group ticket time rose about 4 minutes in October 2024 across all nine locations. The board had projected and accepted that rise, with a 19-minute ceiling, for the made-to-order menu, which was priced 15% higher. Satisfaction and sales are up, and the 12-minute benchmark panel excludes scratch kitchens. The Riverside spike dates from the August 2026 loss of the saute/pasta cook. The position is unfilled, and group operations deferred the transfer requests. The KDS data localizes the delay to that station. No other location shows a staffing problem. Par-cooked trials cut food quality, and a past ticket-time bonus caused KDS bumping. Why Delgado left is unestablished. The repeat-visit rise is confounded by the switch in measurement method.
